headline: Man United players get Thursday day off despite Como thrashing - sources
description: Manchester United's first-team squad will report back for training on Friday after being given a day off today following the humiliating 4-1 Champions League defeat against Como, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United consider defensive clearout in summer
description: Manchester United are considering refreshing their back four, with three senior defender's contracts up at the end of the season. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal eye move for Brugge's Tresoldi
description: Arsenal are monitoring a possible move for Club Brugge striker Nicolò Tresoldi. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Ruben Amorim with 'nothing to say' about Man United on return to England
description: Ruben Amorim insisted he had "nothing to say" about Manchester United ahead of AC Milan's Europa League clash at Bournemouth on Thursday night.

headline: Who could replace Carrick after Man United's worst start since 1986?
description: Manchester United have struggled this season, but which managers could step in to replace Michael Carrick if the club sacks him?
